# Sanctioned apiKeyHelper mentions, keyed by a hash of FILE + CLAUSE + which
# OCCURRENCE of that clause in that file (whitespace-normalised, so reflowing
# prose does not churn this file but rewording does).
#
# WHY AN ALLOWLIST. apiKeyHelper shadows a healthy claude.ai OAuth login on
# claude-code >= 2.1.205 and was retired on 2026-07-10 after a multi-day mesh
# outage (anthropics/claude-code#11587, ce-77ip). Earlier versions of the guard
# tried to judge whether prose recommended or disclaimed the wiring and were
# defeated repeatedly; distinguishing those needs parsing, not pattern matching.
# So every mention is listed here, which makes adding or rewording one a
# deliberate act a human reviews.
#
# WHY FILE + CLAUSE + OCCURRENCE. Keying on text alone lets one entry authorise
# that sentence anywhere in the repository. Adding the file was not enough
# either: a warning duplicated verbatim later in the SAME file hashes
# identically and would exempt an active use. The ordinal makes each site
# reviewable on its own.
#
# To add an entry: run
#   go test ./internal/deploy/ -run TestNoAPIKeyHelperInstructions
# The failure prints the clause and the exact line to paste. Read the clause
# first -- if it recommends the wiring, delete the prose instead of listing it.
#
# Stale entries fail the test, so this file cannot drift into fiction.
